units.source_text: 三公主负疚在心，见了源氏满面羞惭，瑟缩不安，问她话也难得回答。

en.t: Burdened by guilt, the Third Princess blushed with shame when she saw Genji, shrinking back uneasily and barely able to answer when he spoke to her.

units.source_text: 源氏推想：自己长久不曾亲近她，难怪她心怀怨恨。

en.t: Genji supposed that, since he had not been close to her for so long, it was only natural that she should resent him.

units.source_text: 他觉得很可怜，便百般安慰她。

en.t: He pitied her deeply and tried in every way to comfort her.

units.source_text: 他召唤年纪较长的侍女前来，问她们三公主病情如何。

en.t: He summoned the older serving women and asked them about the Third Princess's condition.

units.source_text: 侍女答道：“公主患的不是普通的病。”就把怀孕的痛苦情况报告他。

en.t: The women replied, "Her Highness is not suffering from an ordinary illness," and reported to him the painful signs of pregnancy.

units.source_text: 源氏说：“真想不到，我到现在这年纪，还会有这等事。”

en.t: Genji said, "I truly never expected that something like this would happen to me at my age."

units.source_text: 但心中想道：“和我长年同居的人都不曾有喜，公主未必是怀孕吧。”

en.t: Yet inwardly he thought, "Even the women who lived with me for years never conceived; surely the Princess may not really be pregnant."

units.source_text: 却也并不追问，只觉得三公主病苦之状甚是可怜，对她十分同情。

en.t: Still, he did not press the matter, and only felt deep pity and sympathy for the Third Princess in her suffering.

units.source_text: 他难得到六条院来，不好意思立刻回去，就在三公主处住了二三天。

en.t: Since he had rarely come to Rokujo-in, he felt embarrassed to leave at once and stayed with the Third Princess for two or three days.

units.source_text: 其间心甚挂念紫夫人的病状，不断写信去探问。

en.t: During that time he was deeply worried about Lady Murasaki's illness and kept sending letters to ask after her.

units.source_text: 不知道三公主过失的侍女私下说道：“一会儿不见，就有这许多话要说，不断地写信了。

en.t: The serving women, who knew nothing of the Third Princess's fault, said privately, "After only a short time apart, he has so much to say that he keeps writing letters.

units.source_text: 罢了，我家公主看来不会有出头日子了。”

en.t: Well, it seems our princess will never have a day when things turn in her favor."

units.source_text: 小侍从看见源氏来了，心头忐忑乱跳。

en.t: When the young Jijū saw that Genji had come, her heart beat wildly with anxiety.

units.source_text: 柏木闻知源氏回六条院，竟不知自量，反而吃起醋来，写了一封满纸怨恨的信，叫人送来。

en.t: When Kashiwagi heard that Genji had returned to Rokujo-in, he forgot his place, grew jealous instead, and had a letter full of resentment delivered to her.

units.source_text: 此时源氏正好到厢屋里去一下，三公主室中无人，小侍从便把信呈上。

en.t: At that moment Genji happened to have stepped into the side room, and since no one was in the Third Princess's chamber, the young Jijū presented the letter.

units.source_text: 三公主说道：“你把这种可恶的东西给我看，真讨厌啊！

en.t: The Third Princess said, "How hateful of you to show me such an awful thing!

units.source_text: 我心里越发难过了！”便躺下身子。

en.t: It only makes my heart ache all the more!" Then she lay down.

units.source_text: 小侍从说：“不过，公主请看，这几句附言很可怜呢。”就把信展开在公主面前。

en.t: The young Jijū said, "But please look, my lady; these few lines added at the end are very pitiful," and spread the letter before her.

units.source_text: 此时别的侍女走进来了，小侍从着了慌，连忙把帷屏拉过来遮住公主，自己溜了出去。

en.t: Just then other serving women came in, and the young Jijū panicked, hurriedly pulled a curtain screen across to hide the Princess, and slipped out herself.

units.source_text: 公主正在狼狈之时，源氏走了进来。

en.t: While the Princess was still flustered and helpless, Genji came in.

units.source_text: 公主来不及隐藏信件，便把它塞在坐垫底下。

en.t: The Princess had no time to hide the letter, so she stuffed it under a cushion.

units.source_text: 源氏准备今夜回二条院去，此时过来与三公主告别，对她说道：“你的病看来并无大碍。

en.t: Genji was planning to return to Nijo-in that night, and now came to say farewell to the Third Princess, telling her, "Your illness does not seem to be serious.

units.source_text: 而紫夫人呢，能否痊愈尚不可知。

en.t: As for Lady Murasaki, however, it is still unclear whether she will recover.

units.source_text: 现在我就置之不理，于心不忍，所以还得回去。

en.t: I cannot bear simply to leave her unattended now, so I must go back.

units.source_text: 外间即使有人说我短长，你切不可疑心。

en.t: Even if people outside say things about me, you must not let yourself doubt me.

units.source_text: 不久你自会知道真相。”

en.t: Before long, you will understand the truth for yourself."

units.source_text: 往时三公主总像小孩一般无拘无束地和他说笑，但今天态度非常阴郁，连源氏的脸也不看一看。

en.t: In the past the Third Princess had always talked and laughed with him as freely as a child, but today she was terribly gloomy and would not even look at Genji's face.

units.source_text: 源氏只道是恨他薄情，所以态度如此冷淡。

en.t: Genji merely thought that she was acting so coldly because she resented his neglect.
